title: Apache superset: fast-xml-parser allows users to process XML from JS object without C/C++ based libraries or callbacks…
description: A security vulnerability in Apache Superset affects versions prior to 6.1.0-r8. The issue involves the fast-xml-parser component, which allows users to process XML from JavaScript objects without relying on C/C++ based libraries or callbacks. This vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.1, indicating a medium severity level. A fix is available in version 6.1.0-r8.
